## About
Linda Trimbur established Pittsburgh Fleet Management, Inc., and today it is owned by the second generation, Ryan M. Trimbur. We saw the need for quality, affordable vehicle repairs, and that is still why we open the doors.
Our shop sits in the South Hills of Pittsburgh, in a building put up by family patriarch M.C. Arnoni, who owned and operated a waste hauling business here. It's a big space, and we use it for everything from cars to tractor trailers.
We work with individuals, small businesses, large corporations and governmental agencies, and everyone gets the same personal attention. You'll talk to Ryan directly. We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family.

## Services
- General Repairs: A full range of repair work for every size of vehicle, backed by computerized diagnostic technology.
- Preventative Maintenance Programs: Oil change, lube and filter, tire rotation, fluid replacement, inspections and factory scheduled maintenance to keep your car or truck healthy.
- Tire Sales and Service Alignments: New tires, tire service and alignments.
- Air Conditioning Service: Keep the cab cool when the summer heat sets in.
- Assistance with work overflow for businesses with in-house mechanics: Have your own mechanics but more work than hands? Send the overflow to us.
- Emissions: One reviewer with a full size work van was turned away elsewhere over a specific tail pipe test, and we handled it with no issues.
- Special Fleet Rate: Pick up and delivery for fleets, based on volume.

## FAQ
Q: Can you work on large trucks and vans?
A: Yes. We service all size vehicles, from cars up to tractor trailers.

Q: What is your labor rate?
A: Give us a call and we'll tell you. Compare us with your local dealer.

Q: Do you work with businesses and agencies?
A: We do. Our customers range from individuals to small businesses, large corporations and governmental agencies, and each one gets personal attention.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I use the contact form?
A: If needed, you will hear back within 48-72 hours. For anything sooner, give us a call.
